tagline.zh: 两只鼹鼠矿工，九层矿道，一路用火药桶炸到地心。
tagline.en: Two mole miners, nine levels of mine, and powder kegs all the way down.

desc.en: Finish a run, win or lose.

desc.zh: 打通全部九层，击败熔心巨螯。
desc.en: Clear all nine levels and defeat the Molten Claw.
Defeat the Geode Claw on level 6.

desc.zh: 让四个火药桶在一次连锁里接连爆炸。
desc.en: Set off four kegs in a single chain reaction.

desc.zh: 一局里拾取 12 颗宝石。
通关且没有人被爆炸炸到。
desc.en: Clear the mine without anyone being caught in a blast.
Clear the mine without using a continue.
Clear the mine with two players.

how.zh: 放下火药桶，它会沿十字方向爆炸：岩石挡住火焰，方块会被炸开，露出装备、宝石和升降机舱门；火焰碰到别的火药桶会连锁引爆。消灭本层全部怪物后舱门打开，在空气耗尽前走进去就进入下一层，第六层和第九层各有一只首领。打通九层即通关。被怪物碰到、被落石砸中或被任何爆炸波及（包括自己和同伴的）会失去一条生命并掉落部分装备；空气耗尽时全员失去一条生命。所有人生命耗尽时消耗一次续关重打本层，续关用完则失败。
how.en: Set a powder keg and it goes off in a cross: rock stops the fire, blocks are blown away to reveal gear, gems and the lift hatch, and fire that reaches another keg sets it off too. The hatch opens once every creature on the level is gone; step in before the air runs out to go one level down. Levels 6 and 9 hold a boss, and clearing all nine clears the run. Touching a creature, a falling rock or any blast (your own and your partner's included) costs a life and some gear, and running out of air costs everyone a life. When everybody is out of lives a continue restarts the level; with no continue left the run is lost.

note.zh: 决定生命数、续关次数、怪物速度和每层的时间。
note.en: Sets lives, continues, creature speed and the time for each level.
